svg.title: Mac — Targets
svg.desc: Original static settings design. Synthetic labels and source-default previews only; no runtime queries, audio, configuration writes or app behavior.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Text, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Selection, target permission and reply voice remain separate decisions.
Effective state not queried. Proposed controls require supported host capabilities.
Synthetic label only. Sending requires this connection to confirm a live target.
Name, target ID and current binding are distinct. Offline entries stay visible.
#1124 map is proposed. It is independent of a spoken route alias.
Open / Confirm / Locked. JSON requires an explicit tier; selection grants nothing.
Independent capture permission. Required explicitly in policy JSON.
Owner re-allows to bind a process. Do not offer an arbitrary editable binding string.
Default on. Off changes ambient escalation only; other gates remain in force.
1–48 characters, 1–3 supported words; unique normalized name.
Up to 8 aliases per entry with the same name constraints.
Must identify one configured route; routes never grant policy permission.
Exactly one validated Markdown or Shortcut handler per spoken destination.
Secrets and exact private bindings remain redacted in exports.
Continue in All settings for every field, source and prerequisite. This frame shows representative controls.
STATIC DESIGN · representative category content · synthetic labels · no runtime effects
